title: Sprayable NIR/pH-responsive NSC/PF127 hydrogel loaded with MoO₂, ciprofloxacin, and FGF-2 for enhanced antibacterial and pro-regenerative infected wound healing.
snippet: Infected wounds represent a significant clinical burden owing to persistent infection, excessive inflammation, and impaired tissue regeneration. To overcome these limitations, we developed a sprayable-succinyl chitosan/Pluronic F127 (NSC/PF127) hydrogel incorporating MoO₂ nanoparticles, ciprofloxacin, and fibroblast growth factor-2 (FGF-2).
